svg.title: How the NWSW research system connects
svg.desc: Three checks: Pod human review, Hub human review, and Ingestor verification and scoped reproduction. The same Hub makes the final acceptance decision. Accepted material enters the Library as shared context. Contributors retrieve reviewed findings, corrections and methods for subsequent work.
svg.text: A research network with shared memory
Three checks. Final human acceptance. Reviewed context feeds the next round of work.
Apply reviewed lessons to the next task
Define what the Ingestor must check
Results return to the Hub for acceptance.
The same Hub reviews the check results.
Human authority accepts or returns work
and sets the approved sharing scope.
Findings, corrections, methods and review history
remain linked to their sources and versions.
Approved material within its recorded scope
Iterative contextual learning: later work uses the reviewed record when agents retrieve current context.
Logical review and reuse flow / 21 Oct 2026
